# technitium_group_members (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_group_members` manages, without managing it, found by `group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_group_members" "administrators" {
  group = "Administrators"
}

output "administrators" {
  value = data.technitium_group_members.administrators.members
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) The group name. Changing it moves the resource to another group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `members` (List of String) The usernames of the members, in alphabetical order as the server returns them. An empty list removes all members.
